note: This is the Sky1 arm64 DEFAULT and installer boot kernel under the unified 7.3 policy (operator 2026-10-05): there is no edge channel and assets/kernel/mainline points at this r287 build. r287 = r286 + (a) CONFIG_RT_GROUP_SCHED is no longer set (the kernel root fix for the O6N audio cutouts: with the cgroup v2 cpu controller enabled a RT_GROUP_SCHED kernel gives every child cgroup zero RT runtime, cgroup v2 exposes no per-cgroup rt_runtime knob, so rtkit cannot grant PipeWire's data-loop SCHED_RR and it silently stays SCHED_OTHER) and (b) recipe patches 0013-0021, the still-missing cixtech/cix_opensource__linux cix_k6.6.89_2026q2..q3 fixes (ASoC i2s_mc global-interrupt mask; cdns3/cdnsp RCU-stall, DISABLE_SLOT skip, comp_desc NULL guards; dptx out-of-bound HPD, physical dp->status/MST HPD, eDP-only PSR caps, GOP-plug-after-HDCP; typec rts5453 portX/orientation). CONFIG_RT_GROUP_SCHED changes struct task_struct/sched_rt_entity layout, so the exported-symbol CRCs MOVED (535 across the accelerator imports): unlike r285->r286, ALL SIX committed accelerator overlays are REBUILT against the r287 Module.symvers and re-mirrored (verify-overlay-modversions: 0 CRC mismatches). The PCIe default is unchanged (sky1_pcie_native=off pcie_pnp_en). The rescue entry boots this same kernel with the arm64 accelerator blacklist. Replaced by 7.3.0 final later.
